subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 4: Book club – My Muscat diary
outcomes: Find the features of a diary.
Answer questions about a family holiday in Muscat.

tf.why: Yes, each entry starts with a date.

tf.s: A diary is usually written in the first person (I, we).
tf.why: Yes, the writer tells about their own day.

tf.s: The family arrived in Muscat on Saturday 29th December.
tf.why: Yes, they arrived in the evening.

tf.s: The family went to the aquarium on Monday.
tf.why: They went to the aquarium on Sunday afternoon.

tf.s: On Monday, they visited the National Museum and a planetarium.
Dad has had the Royal Opera House tickets since December.
tf.why: He has had them since September.

tf.s: The family is flying home to Salalah.
tf.why: They are flying home to Khasab.

tf.s: We use -ed adjectives to say how we feel.
tf.why: Yes: I was tired, I was excited.
The show causes the feeling, so it was exciting.

tf.s: The writer didn't write on Sunday night because he/she was too tired.
tf.why: Yes, it was a tiring day.

boxes.q: Where is the family flying home to?
Which part of Saturday did they arrive?
boxes.why: They arrived on Saturday 29th December in the evening.

boxes.q: Which places did they visit on Monday?
o: the National Museum and a planetarium
boxes.why: Monday was museum and planetarium day.

boxes.q: When did they go to the aquarium?

boxes.why: -ed tells us how a person feels.

boxes.q: Which is a feature of a diary?

hunt.q: A diary uses I and we: ___ person

mcq.q: What are two features of a diary?
mcq.why: Diaries have dates and use I/we.

mcq.q: When did the family arrive in Muscat?
o: On Saturday 29th December, in the evening

mcq.q: Since when has Dad had the tickets for the Royal Opera House?
Which two places did they visit on Monday?
o: The National Museum and a planetarium
The art gallery and the aquarium
The Royal Opera House and a zoo
The long walk was tiring. I was tired.
The long walk was tired. I was tiring.
The walk was tire. I was tiring.
The walk was tiring. I was tiring.
mcq.why: -ing for the cause, -ed for the feeling.

mcq.q: Which is the best start for a diary entry?
o: Friday 3rd May. We visited the aquarium today.
Dear Sir, I am writing to you.
Once upon a time, there was a king.
mcq.why: A diary entry starts with a date and uses we/I.

mcq.q: Ali got a low mark and his friends laughed. How did he feel?
Why didn't the writer write the diary on Sunday night?
mcq.why: After a busy day, the writer was too tired.

mcq.q: True or false? The family went to the aquarium on Monday.
o: False – they went on Sunday afternoon.
True – they went on Monday night.
mcq.why: Check the date of each entry.

mcq.q: What is the difference between bored and boring?
o: Bored says how you feel; boring describes what causes it.
Boring is for people; bored is for things.
Bored is the future; boring is the past.
